dt.15-02-2023 the petitioner is compelled to approach this Hon'ble court by way of filing instant writ application or, (II) For directing the respondents to pay adequate Vijay Kumar Gupta vs The State Of Bihar on 15 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/199430830/
1 compensation to the petitioner and a Government job to the spouse of the petitioner,
for illegally encroaching the land of the petitioner by illegally encroaching the land of the petitioner and by cutting the soil 20 feet deep, from the rest land of the petitioner and constructing a road (Agamkuan- Kamaldah NH-30 link road) through the land of the petitioner, passing through the purchased/
commercial land of the petitioner, which is one of the source of livelihood for the petitioner,

sentences.text: appertaining to Tauji no. 267, Thana no. 14, Khata no. 591, part of Khesra-289, of land has been illegally encroached by the respondents, whereas the petitioner is paying rent of the land in question to the government and rent receipt has also been issued."

At the outset, the learned counsel for the State has submitted that the road constructed over the private raiyati land of the petitioner has already stood removed during the interregnum period, which is not disputed by the learned Patna High Court CWJC No.23108 of 2019(7) dt.15-02-2023 counsel for the petitioner, hence nothing survives for consideration in the present petition.

Accordingly, the present writ petition stands disposed off as not pressed in view of the stand taken by the respondent-State not only in the counter affidavit filed in the present case but also, as aforesaid.
